```{=html}
<script>
  // Merge the three "Recent updates" listings into one list sorted by date
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    // The about template emits root-absolute internal links ("/cv/index.html"),
    // which break when the site is opened from disk; make them page-relative.
    document.querySelectorAll('a.about-link[href^="/"]:not([href^="//"])')
      .forEach(a => a.setAttribute("href", a.getAttribute("href").replace(/^\/(\.\/)?/, "")));

    const lists = [...document.querySelectorAll(".home-card .recent-updates")];
    if (lists.length < 2) return;
    const items = lists.flatMap(ul => [...ul.children]);
    items.sort((a, b) =>
      Number(b.dataset.listingDateSort || 0) - Number(a.dataset.listingDateSort || 0));
    items.forEach(li => lists[0].appendChild(li));
    lists.slice(1).forEach(ul => ul.closest(".frontpage-listing").remove());
  });
</script>
```
